morphology.pattern_note: peN-在元音开头的edar前实现为peng-；词根é读/e/并保留，不发生首辅音脱落。词根Jawi及读音见DBP。[DBP：edar](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=edar)

senses.zh_definition: 分发、发行或分销的活动；把资料、出版物或货物送到不同接收者手中或投入流通的过程。
senses.en_definition: The act, activity, or process of distributing or circulating materials, publications, or goods.
senses.ms_definition: Perihal, usaha atau kegiatan mengedarkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 依据资料包所引《Kamus Dewan》第四版释义整理。侧重分发或流通活动；不等于交通、运输，也不必然表示按份额分配。涉及按对象或份额分配时，pengagihan可能更准确。[DBP：pengedaran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?keyword=pengedaran)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengedaran risalah tentang pencegahan denggi akan dilaksanakan di kawasan perumahan itu pada hari Sabtu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 有关预防登革热的传单将于星期六在该住宅区分发。
dual_scenarios.en: Leaflets on dengue prevention will be distributed in the residential area on Saturday.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Pengedaran risalah kat sini dah selesai ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah pengedaran risalah di sini sudah selesai?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这边的传单都发完了吗？
dual_scenarios.en: Have we finished handing out the leaflets here?
spoken_features: 口语常把较正式的pengedaran换说成发放动作，如edar risalah

messages.speaker: Farah (志愿者同伴)
messages.ms_spoken: Pengedaran risalah kat blok A dah selesai ke? Kita nak gerak ke blok B.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah pengedaran risalah di blok A sudah selesai? Kita hendak bergerak ke blok B.
messages.zh: A座的传单发完了吗？我们准备去B座。
messages.en: Have we finished handing out the leaflets in Block A? We're about to move on to Block B.

messages.speaker: Amir (志愿者同伴)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum, tinggal dua tingkat je. Tunggu kejap ya.
messages.ms_standard: Belum selesai; hanya dua tingkat lagi yang tinggal. Sila tunggu sebentar.
messages.zh: 还没，只剩两层了。等一下啊。
messages.en: Not yet—just two floors left. Give us a moment.

etymology.historical_story: Pengedaran illustrates how Malay builds an activity noun around edar. The related verb mengedarkan describes distributing something, while pengedaran names the activity itself. The dictionary's leaflet example makes the relationship concrete: papers pass from a distributor to readers. The same productive word family also supports the vocabulary of publishing and commerce.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把edar想成“送出去、传开来”：mengedarkan是“分发”，pengedaran给整个分发过程起名字。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 适用于行政通知、物流、出版及社区活动，语气中性正式；日常交流也可直接说edar risalah等动作表达。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 词本身不带违法含义，具体对象决定褒贬。pengedaran dadah通常指毒品贩运；合法药品的分销应使用ubat或具体药品名称，避免歧义。
